facts.fact: Adwave cites that 52% of marketers consider Google Local Pack positions their number one metric for SEO success.
facts.quote: a remarkable **52% of marketers** now consider Google Local Pack positions their number one metric for SEO success.

facts.fact: Adwave's example describes a query with 5,000 impressions and only 20 clicks as a sign of high visibility but low click-through rate.
facts.quote: A query with **5,000 impressions** and only **20 clicks** is a massive red flag, and a golden opportunity.

facts.fact: In Google Search Console, users access the Performance report and click the '+ New' button to add filters for local keyword analysis.
facts.quote: Just head to "Performance" and click the "+ New" button to start slicing the data.

facts.fact: For manual local rank checks, the guide recommends using a new Incognito window to prevent personal search history, location, and signed-in account from skewing results.
facts.quote: open a new Incognito window**. This is important because it prevents your personal search history, location, and signed-in Google account from skewing the results.

facts.fact: To set a location for manual checks, the guide says to scroll to the bottom of the Google search page and click 'Update location'.
facts.quote: scroll to the very bottom of the Google search page and click "Update location."

facts.fact: The page recommends that most local businesses check their local rankings on a weekly basis.
facts.quote: For most local businesses, a **weekly check-in** is the perfect rhythm.

facts.fact: The page suggests saving time-consuming manual SERP checks and geogrid reports for a monthly or quarterly review.
facts.quote: Save the more time-consuming manual SERP checks or geogrid reports for a monthly or quarterly review.
